title: Rabbi Chanina bar Agil
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Bava Kamma 54b–55a he asked Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba: “Why is ‘good’ not stated in the first Commandments, while in the latter Commandments ‘good’ is stated?” He said to him: “… Go to Rabbi Tanchum bar Chanilai” — he went to him, etc. In Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 6:6: Rabbi Chanina bar Agul in the name of Rabbi Chizkiyah. He is mentioned in Midrash Abba Gurion on the verse “And when were fulfilled,” and there bar Igul; and in Esther Rabbah 2:5 the statement is attributed to Rabbi Chanina bar Atal.

notes.text: The consulted Bava Kamma 54b–55a directly names Chanina son of Agil and the referral to Tanchum bar Chanilai. Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 6:6 has Chanina bar Agul in Chizkiyah’s name. The exact Abba Gurion and Esther Rabbah forms Igul and Atal remain Hyman’s reports.
